name: 28144 · Salisbury, NC
findings: ZIP 28144 (Salisbury) has 137 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28144 (Salisbury) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28144 (Salisbury) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
